name: Buffovi i pojašanja
description:
Pojašanja se navlače bez vezivanja i kopči, pa tokom dana menjaju ulogu: grejač za vrat, zaštita od vetra ili traka za glavu. U ovoj kategoriji su muški buffovi sa tankom flis podstavom, u crnoj, sivoj i plavoj boji.

Podstava je tamo gde vetar najviše hladi, oko vrata i sa strane lica, a ispod ovratnika jakne ne pravi debeo sloj. Dok se nosi, buff se povlači prema gore kada ojača vetar i spušta do ovratnika kada se uđe u topao prostor, bez skidanja i premotavanja.

Svaki model se lako navlači, peri i brzo suši, pa se pre nošenja sklapa u džep ranca. Boja se bira prema ostatku zimske opreme: crna ide uz sve, siva skriva prašinu s puta, plava je akcenat uz mornarski plavu jaknu.
en_description:
Buffs and neck gaiters pull on without tying or clips, then change jobs during the day: neck warmer, wind guard or headband. This collection holds the men's fleece-lined buffs in black, grey and blue.

The lining sits where the cold bites hardest, around the neck and the sides of the face, and stays thin enough to disappear under a jacket collar. In a gust the tube is pulled up over the cheeks; indoors it slides back down to the collar, without taking anything off.

Each one takes a wash, dries quickly and folds into almost nothing before it goes into a pocket. Pick the colour against the rest of the winter kit: black goes with everything, grey hides road spray, blue adds a note next to a navy jacket.
